# Sina

> Software engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, building calm, well-made products. Backends in Go with PostgreSQL, interfaces in Svelte and SvelteKit. Open to work.

Site: https://ebnsina.dev
Email: ebnsina.dev@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/ebnsina

## Selected work

- Alchemist: VOD transcoder. Upload once, get adaptive streams out. Go, FFmpeg, PostgreSQL.
- Fajr LMS: learning platform for schools and madrasahs in South Asia and the Gulf. Go, SvelteKit.
- Tavora: website, dashboard and till for restaurants in Bangladesh. Go, SvelteKit.
- Safar: buses, trains and flights across Bangladesh from one search. SvelteKit, Drizzle.
- Sina UI: small copy-in Svelte component library. Svelte, TypeScript.

## How I work

- Simple under load: the shortest solution that works, measured before it grows.
- API first: the interface is the product, errors are structured and stable.
- Halal software: no dark patterns, no hidden fees, nothing that works against the person using it.
